meta.title: Tax Sale Investment Research
meta.disclaimer: Research aid only. A tax lien is not ownership of a property. No listing shown as a bundle without official current documentation. Value estimates require comps and a dated method. This independent research page is not an offer, charitable program, or use of charitable funds.
meta.imagePolicy: Property photographs must be licensed or supplied by authorized auction sources. Google Street View opens on Google Maps; Google imagery is not downloaded or rehosted.
meta.summary: No independently budget-qualified active tax-sale bundle confirmed in this review. Five additional closed 2–3-parcel Michigan deed bundles archived; one unpriced upcoming Tennessee bankruptcy multi-package auction tracked separately for diligence (NOT tax sale).

investmentCriteria.notes: Prefer affordable genuine bundled acquisition opportunities. Estimated total cost includes minimum bid or portfolio face amount where relevant, fees, taxes, premium and mandatory known costs. Unknown price must be flagged for manual screening, not represented as affordable.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 7965 · Saginaw 97-parcel bundle
archiveExamples.note: Actual tax-foreclosed deed parcels, grouped in one lot; $17,828.30 in current-year taxes and performance-bond conditions were also shown in the catalog. Closed 30 October 2026; not available at this minimum today.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 8798 · Genesee vacant-lot bundle
archiveExamples.note: Vacant-lot deed bundle. Catalog title says 114 parcels, but detailed list enumerates 115; reconcile before any future offer. Current taxes shown $17,397.61. Closed 30 October 2026; advertised minimum no longer available.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 8799 · Genesee demolition bundle
archiveExamples.note: Tax-foreclosed property bundle with demolition and performance-bond requirements. Title says 198 but detailed list enumerates 199. Current-year taxes shown $182,849.97 in addition to minimum. Closed 30 October 2026; major liability and occupancy concerns.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 8132 · Two vacant lots, E Alcott Street
archiveExamples.note: Verified single auction lot with both vacant parcels (~0.27 acres combined). Historical minimum $200 before tax, 10% buyer's premium and recording fees. Closed; no current sale confirmed. Due diligence: land use, access, utilities, contamination.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 5446 · Liberty Street vacant-land bundle
archiveExamples.note: Two tax parcels sold only together; ~0.16 acres combined. Historical bid minimum, not a current purchase price. County's old SEV is not market value.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 5448 · Washington Street vacant-land bundle
archiveExamples.note: Two adjacent tax parcels sold as one lot (~0.15 acres combined). Historical minimum only; final winning bid not independently confirmed.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 5450 · Three Henderson Street parcels
archiveExamples.note: Three tax parcels (~0.35 acres combined) sold in one lot. Historical minimum and 2026 current tax, buyer premium and recording not included; closed October 30.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 6306 · Port Huron house and adjacent lot
archiveExamples.note: A two-story house and a second vacant tax parcel offered as one auction lot. Closed August 4; historical minimum, not current availability. House condition, title and vacant-lot legal description require verification.

researchLeads.name: Hidden Valley Lakes — Ten Multi-Parcel Packages
researchLeads.category: Court-ordered bankruptcy deed auction — NOT tax sale
researchLeads.location: 0 Hidden Valley Road, Hidden Valley Lakes, Nunnelly, TN 37137
researchLeads.note: Court-ordered absolute bankruptcy sale of 100 recreational/residential parcels offered in ten separate packages. Auctioneer says highest bidders win regardless of price; NOT a tax sale. Individual package boundaries, parcel IDs and current bids were not visible in the public page; do NOT assume each package is ten parcels or affordable.
researchLeads.risks: Unverified package-level prices and parcel descriptions, possible subdivision restrictions and assessments, rural access, unverified buildability, no contingencies, 10% buyer premium, 10% earnest deposit, closing 30 days or within 15 days of court approval. Buyer must inspect full property information package.
researchLeads.qualifier: Research lead only, not approved as within budget. Do not convert to verified active affordable bundle until each package's parcels, acquisition cost and legal terms are verified.
